card.name: Then, here, there after a preposition
card.fires_on: Place or time adverbs like then, here, there, today right after a preposition such as since, by, before, near, from. They stand in for an already mentioned time or place.

modes.label: Time: since/by/before then
modes.description: The word then after a preposition, pointing back to an earlier time in the text.
modes.example: More than 300 climbers have scaled the highest mountain since<< then>>. Also

modes.label: Place: near here/there
modes.description: Here or there after near or from, pointing to a place already named.
modes.example: The foundations of an ancient synagogue were discovered near<< there>> in 1929 by explor
